findings.title: Açılan gündüz çabaları görünür bir ahlaki alana taşır
findings.claim: The focus's daylight and unveiling carriers can make otherwise covered differences in striving and their consequences publicly legible.
findings.mechanism: The daylight branch supplies an open field and the manifestation branch supplies uncovering; the supplied social-conditioning and seeing/accounting connections provide wider instances where light makes conduct and consequence perceptible, so the focus opening returns as moral legibility.
findings.reader_payoff: The oath's daylight becomes newly perceptible as the moment hidden divergence becomes readable, so its opening bears on what actions are becoming.
findings.containment: The ayah remains an oath by daylight when it unveils; moral legibility is a bounded contextual resonance. The reciprocal review on 34:33 records daylight alone as no-value in the reverse direction, so no general day motif or verdict is claimed.

epistemic.reason: Trusted publication evidence and legacy reader-walk evidence share exact focus returns; the transfer from physical unveiling to moral legibility is an inferred, connection-grounded relation.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Daylight becomes a public field in which hidden differences in striving can become morally readable.
branch_activations.boundary: The interval remains ordinary daylight; only its contextual effect of legibility is added.
